{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease at baseline
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Exclude sentinel values (-999.0) from biomarker_baseline
valid_biomarker = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker = valid_biomarker.mean()

# Print the number of valid observations and the mean
print(f"Number of valid baseline biomarker values: {len(valid_biomarker)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_biomarker}")"}
